$Comment: What Lanterns in the Temple pays when the player finds Old Jack: a small welcome of sweets,
through the Currency reward kind, since a counter wallet has no item to hand over. The quest
pays this table in its Auto bucket, the moment it is handed in, so nothing waits to be collected
on the way to Pumpkin Patch's offer. A companion mod adds its own rolls to this table with a
file of its own that names it in ContributesTo, so nothing here has to change.
Name: Hallows_Eve_Meet_Pay
